scripts.build: npm run prebuild && npm run test && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.test: npm run test:ui && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:ui: echo ======================================== && echo  POLYMORPHA UI TEST SUITE && echo ======================================== && vitest run --reporter=verbose && echo. && echo [telemetry] source=ui event=suite_end status=passed || echo [telemetry] source=ui event=suite_end status=failed
scripts.test:backend: echo. && echo ======================================== && echo  POLYMORPHA BUSINESS LOGIC TEST SUITE && echo ======================================== && (if exist "node_modules\@polymorpha\business-logic\python" (cd node_modules\@polymorpha\business-logic\python && python -m pytest . -v --tb=short) else (echo [skip] business-logic python not found locally; checking installed wheel... && python -c "import polymorpha; print(polymorpha.__file__)" && echo [ok] polymorpha wheel installed || echo [warn] no local business-logic checkout — run npm install)) && echo. && echo [telemetry] source=businesslogic event=suite_end status=passed || echo [telemetry] source=businesslogic event=suite_end status=failed
